no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no advisory committee meeting held. The following wording is recommended for inclusion in the action letter to explain the rationale for this decision.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for TASIGNA (nilotinib) NDA022068. The review documents state the application was not taken to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the Office of Oncology Drug Products had previously accepted cytogenetic response (chronic phase CML) and hematologic response (accelerated phase CML) as approval endpoints, and because the major toxicities could be managed with dose modifications, dose interruption, attention to concomitant medications, and safety monitoring. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
